messages:
anya_docs: FYI opened a docs PR that adds a 'route-level cost attribution' dashboard example + tiny SDK snippets for python/go. playground preview is failing though, looks like the tracehook snippet has the wrong env var name. can someone take a quick look?

jess_m: link?

anya_docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523 — failing preview at `Playground preview (docs)` job. error is a 400 from trace ingest.

miles_infra: quick guess: the snippet uses `TRACE_API_KEY` instead of the runtime's `TRACE_KEY`. seen that mixup before in runtime examples.

samuel: yep that will cause 400. also the example sets `REDWOOD_ENV` to `prod` which breaks the sandbox routing in preview. should be `dev` or omitted.

anya_docs: ugh, I must've copy-pasted from the Dedicated guide. easy fix. can one of you push a patch so I don't have to cycle CI again?

jess_m: I can open a small fix PR. will swap to `TRACE_KEY` and remove `REDWOOD_ENV`. also will add a one-line test in CI to smoke the playground snippet to avoid future regressions. :+1:

devex-bot: Preview deployed — https://playground.redwood.test/pr-4523-preview (expires in 24h)

miles_infra: when you update could you also tweak the cost/latency breakdown example? the dashboard YAML uses `cost_usd` but our telemetry exports `cost_cents` for now. tiny rename in the sample will save confusion.

jess_m: good catch. i'll patch both in a single PR. plan: update env var, adjust dashboard YAML field to `cost_cents`, and add a note in the snippet docs about conversion to dollars.

anya_docs: perfect. once jess has the patch i'll re-run docs preview and then merge if green. also would love a one-line Python snippet that demonstrates reading trace metadata and extracting `route` for attribution — we don't have a compact example yet.

samuel: minimal python example:```python
from redwood import TraceHook

hook = TraceHook(api_key=os.getenv("TRACE_KEY"))
trace = hook.fetch_latest()
route = trace.metadata.get("route")
print(f"route={route}, latency_ms={trace.latency_ms}")
```

anya_docs: that's great — i'll paste that into the PR as the inline snippet.

jess_m: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4524 — includes env var fix, YAML key rename, and the python snippet from @samuel. running CI now.

miles_infra: will watch preview and do a quick sanity check on the dashboard rendering. if anything else pops up i'll ping here.

anya_docs: thank you all! if merge is blocked I'll reassign the PR to @jess_m to handle merge conflicts. :rocket:
